title: Outward Flux Across a Sphere via the Divergence Theorem
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute the outward flux of F = <x, y, z> across the sphere x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = a^2 for a = 2.

steps.title: Compute Divergence of F
steps.mathExpression: \nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = \frac{\partial x}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial y}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial z} = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3
steps.explanation: Compute the sum of partial derivatives.

steps.title: Apply Divergence Theorem
steps.explanation: Multiply constant divergence 3 by sphere volume.
